_about: Public-domain John Miley (1813-1895), Methodist Episcopal theologian of Drew Theological Seminary, for the Word Hoard: Treatise on Class Meetings (1851), The Atonement in Christ (1879) and Systematic Theology (2 vols, 1892-1894), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 52 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
